label: /speckit:handoff and the session-relaunch loop are absent from system-spec-kit SKILL.md and references: the owning skill's keyword list names only the packet handover doc, while the command index lists handoff as a first-class command, so a continue-later request routes to /speckit:save handover maintenance and never reaches the runtime relaunch loop that ships off by default.

The speckit command README self-describes as a 9-command index at README.txt:116 while its COMMANDS table lists ten after handoff was appended, so the one field a reader uses to notice a missing command is wrong.

The relaunch enable switch is absent from references/config/environment-variables.md (211 lines, zero SESSION_RELAUNCH matches) while .env.example carries 20, so the default flip that turned handover off ships invisible to the skill that owns spec continuity.

sync-phase-map-status.ts is documented as a runnable .ts entry but imports ../lib/esm-entry.js which exists only under dist/, so the documented invocation exits 1 with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND while the compiled dist copy exits 0; it is the only .ts in runtime/cli/spec with that import.

Nothing invokes sync-phase-map-status: no YAML, command doc, hook or CI entry names it, and the phase workflow still says fill the parent Phase Documentation Map by hand, so removing the script breaks only its vitest suite and one README row while validate.sh loses the only check for a canon-required table.
The v4.0.0.11..v4.0.0.12 diffstat is four files, all regenerated: runtime/data/trigger-index.json plus three retrieval fixtures. A release was cut for an index rebuild with no code change.

v4.0.0.13's 82-file diffstat is dominated by the regenerated trigger index (93k lines); the reviewable code is the claude hooks shared/compact-inject/session-prime trio, spec-gate-core.mjs and three new vitest suites.
